query: SELECT t.type_name, SUM(v.load_capacity) AS total_load FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY t.type_name;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM transportation.shipping_company GROUP BY status;
SELECT LEFT(area_id,4) AS city_code, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '32%' GROUP BY LEFT(area_id,4);

SELECT business_type, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM (SELECT business_type FROM transportation.vehicle_company UNION ALL SELECT business_type FROM transportation.shipping_company UNION ALL SELECT business_type FROM energy.energy_company) AS all_companies GROUP BY business_type;
SELECT business_type, COUNT(company_id) AS company_count FROM transportation.shipping_company GROUP BY business_type;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vessel WHERE max_load > 50000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.driver WHERE license_type = 'A2';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '21%';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '36%';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE area_id LIKE '63%';
SELECT mmsi, max_load FROM transportation.vessel WHERE max_load < 5000;
SELECT mmsi, sog FROM vessel_ais_data WHERE sog >= 25
SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE load_capacity IS NULL;
SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE model = 'X5';
SELECT name FROM transportation.driver WHERE birth_date > '1990-12-31';
SELECT name FROM transportation.employee WHERE gender = '女';
SELECT name FROM transportation.driver WHERE license_type = 'C1';
SELECT plate_number, brand FROM transportation.vehicle;
SELECT plate_number FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE load_capacity > (SELECT AVG(load_capacity) FROM transportation.vehicle);

SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(v.vehicle_id) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle_company c LEFT JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON c.company_id = v.company_id GROUP BY c.company_id, c.company_name;

SELECT vc.company_name, COALESCE(SUM(v.load_capacity), 0) AS total_load FROM transportation.vehicle_company vc LEFT JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON vc.company_id = v.company_id GROUP BY vc.company_id, vc.company_name;
SELECT sc.company_name, AVG(v.max_speed) AS average_speed FROM transportation.shipping_company sc JOIN transportation.vessel v ON sc.company_id = v.company_id GROUP BY sc.company_id;

SELECT a.province_name AS province, t.type_name AS vehicle_type, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code JOIN common.administrative_division a ON v.area_id = a.id GROUP BY a.province_name, t.type_name ORDER BY a.province_name, t.type_name;

SELECT v.brand, ad.province_name, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON v.area_id = ad.id GROUP BY v.brand, ad.province_name ORDER BY v.brand, ad.province_name;
SELECT AVG(v.load_capacity) AS avg_load FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.area_id LIKE '3201%' AND t.type_name = '货车';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code WHERE v.area_id LIKE '2301%' AND t.type_name = '货车' AND v.load_capacity > 15;
SELECT v.mmsi FROM transportation.vessel v JOIN common.vessel_type_dict vt ON v.vessel_type = vt.type_code WHERE vt.type_name = '军事舰艇';
SELECT * FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE LEFT(area_id,2) IN ('31','32','33','34');
SELECT plate_number, load_capacity FROM transportation.vehicle WHERE brand = '福田' AND load_capacity > 10;

SELECT t.type_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity <= 5 THEN 1 END) AS `轻型`, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity > 5 AND v.load_capacity <= 15 THEN 1 END) AS `中型`, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.load_capacity > 15 THEN 1 END) AS `重型` FROM transportation.vehicle v JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code GROUP BY t.type_name
SELECT stock_name, listing_date FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE listing_date < '2015-01-01';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) AS enterprise_count FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2025;
SELECT t.open_price, t.close_price FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE s.stock_code = '000001' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE is_restricted_industry = FALSE;
SELECT stock_name, current_price * total_shares AS current_total_market_cap FROM finance_tax.stocks WHERE market_class = 'A';
SELECT c.company_name, r.revenue FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY r.revenue DESC;

SELECT c.company_name, cur.revenue - prev.revenue AS revenue_difference FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns cur JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON cur.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns prev ON prev.company_id = cur.company_id AND prev.tax_year = 2024 WHERE cur.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY c.company_name

SELECT c.company_name, r.revenue FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN common.dict_registration_type rt ON c.registration_type_code = rt.type_code WHERE rt.type_name = '港澳台商投资企业' ORDER BY r.revenue DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE c.is_private = TRUE GROUP BY i.industry_name ORDER BY company_count DESC;

SELECT (f.total_assets * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS bps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '贵州茅台' AND f.report_date = '2025-03-31';

SELECT s.stock_name, (MAX(t.high_price) - MIN(t.low_price)) / AVG(t.close_price) AS volatility_ratio FROM finance_tax.stocks s INNER JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY s.stock_id, s.stock_name;

SELECT s.stock_name, (t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS pb FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY pb DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT AVG(revenue - non_taxable_income - deductions - prior_year_losses) AS average_taxable_income FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns WHERE tax_year = 2025;

SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.10 AS tax_saved FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '腾讯控股' AND r.tax_year = 2024;

SELECT DISTINCT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON c.company_id = r.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND r.non_taxable_income / r.revenue > 0.5;
